text:
### Decision Matrix: Which Address to Update  
| Account Type | Address To Use | Reason | Special Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SmartSaver** | Personal residence | Statements sent here | Can be different per account |
| **Current** | Primary residence | Checks sent here | Usually same as SmartSaver |
| **Mortgage** | Property address (don't change) + Personal (change) | Property address locked to deed | Two separate fields |
| **Joint Account** | Confirm both holders' addresses | Statements to primary address | May differ for each holder |
name: Chunk 12/52

raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account
raw_entities.description: A savings product where statements are sent to the customer's personal residence address. The address can be configured differently per account.
context: SmartSaver | Personal residence | Statements sent here | Can be different per account

raw_entities.name: Current Account
raw_entities.description: A current account product where checks are sent to the customer's primary residence. The address is usually the same as the SmartSaver account address.
context: Current | Primary residence | Checks sent here | Usually same as SmartSaver

raw_entities.name: Mortgage
raw_entities.description: A mortgage product with two separate address fields: the property address (locked to the deed and not changeable) and the personal address (changeable).
context: Mortgage | Property address (don't change) + Personal (change) | Property address locked to deed | Two separate fields

raw_entities.name: Joint Account
raw_entities.description: A joint account arrangement where both account holders' addresses must be confirmed. Statements are sent to the primary holder's address, though addresses may differ for each holder.
context: Joint Account | Confirm both holders' addresses | Statements to primary address | May differ for each holder

raw_entities.name: Personal Residence Address
raw_entities.description: The customer's personal residence address used for SmartSaver account statements. This address can be configured differently per account and is updatable.
context: SmartSaver | Personal residence | Statements sent here | Can be different per account

raw_entities.name: Primary Residence Address
raw_entities.description: The customer's primary residence address used for Current account checks. This address is usually the same as the SmartSaver account address.
context: Current | Primary residence | Checks sent here | Usually same as SmartSaver

raw_entities.name: Mortgage Property Address
raw_entities.description: The address of the mortgaged property, locked to the deed and not changeable by the customer. This is a separate field from the personal address on mortgage accounts.
context: Mortgage | Property address (don't change) + Personal (change) | Property address locked to deed | Two separate fields

raw_entities.name: Mortgage Personal Address
raw_entities.description: The customer's personal address on a mortgage account, separate from the property address. This field is changeable by the customer.
context: Mortgage | Property address (don't change) + Personal (change) | Property address locked to deed | Two separate fields

raw_entities.name: Primary Account Holder
raw_entities.description: The primary holder of a joint account whose address is used for statement delivery. On joint accounts, the primary holder's address may differ from the secondary holder's address.
context: Joint Account | Confirm both holders' addresses | Statements to primary address | May differ for each holder

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Holder
raw_entities.description: A holder of a joint account whose address must be confirmed during account setup or update. Joint account holders may have different addresses from the primary holder.
context: Joint Account | Confirm both holders' addresses | Statements to primary address | May differ for each holder
